@Image1 is Eamon: Elderly man, thin, weathered skin, grey hair cropped short, sharp jaw, kind blue eyes, wearing Heavy wool peacoat, dark blue sweater, worn leather boots; A brass compass on a chain around his neck, always glowing faintly. Keep this exact face, hair and outfit.
@Image2 is Vael: Personification of a storm: a swirling vortex of dark clouds, with fleeting, luminous blue eyes and crackling lightning veins, wearing None, just shifting cloud forms; Eyes of lightning that flicker and a constant low rumbling presence. Keep this exact face, hair and outfit.
Each referenced person appears exactly once in frame.
The keeper offers his lamp's warmth, and the storm calms. Location: Lighthouse gallery, night, Night, but storm clearing.
[0s–8s] Hero reaches out a hand toward the storm, which recoils slightly, its eyes flickering.
[8s–16s] Hero opens the lamp housing, warm amber light spills out; storm's tendrils swirl around it, calming.
[16s–24s] Storm's eyes soften, its form becomes more fluid; hero and storm share a quiet moment.
Camera: Close-up on hero's hand reaching out, then pull back to a two-shot, slow zoom out as the light envelops them.
Continuity: Light from lamp bathes both, storm's form now less jagged, more fluid, hero's compass is bright, rain begins to abate.
Audio: Wind subsides, gentle chimes, soft strings, distant thunder rumbles. Dialogue: [10s–14s] @Image1 says "Stay. You're not alone." (Gruff but gentle, soft-spoken.); [16s–18s] @Image2 says "Warm..." (Echoing, layered whispers like wind.). No subtitles or on-screen text.
Style: Hand-drawn animation with watercolour textures, reminiscent of a graphic novel. Deep blues, teal, and warm amber light. Soft, diffused lighting with glowing edges. The lighthouse beam cuts through mist. Early 20th century, rustic, isolated. Non-photorealistic, painterly rendering.
